programme.desc: Një udhëtim për të zbuluar dizajnin dhe mjeshtërinë e superjahteve më mbresëlënëse në botë, duke rrëmuar kështu industrinë e fshehtë dhe ekskluzive.

programme.title: Gjuajtja perfekte
programme.desc: Një cikël interesant për të gjithë të apasionuarit pas armëve ku qitës të specialiteteve të ndryshme që do të rivalizojnë si në skuadra ashtu edhe individualisht me armë moderne dhe të vjetra e ku çdo javë do të eleminohet një qitës.

programme.title: Dita zero
programme.desc: Cfarë është ’Dita zero’ në informatikë? A është një katastrofë kibernetike ndoshta e pakthyeshme? Sa kohë kanë në dispozicion projektuesit e programeve, për ta ndalur këtë proces? A kemi një rast konkret? Le të njihemi me vitusin Stuxnet...

programme.title: Dita zero
programme.desc: Cfarë është ’Dita zero’ në informatikë? A është një katastrofë kibernetike ndoshta e pakthyeshme? Sa kohë kanë në dispozicion projektuesit e programeve, për ta ndalur këtë proces? A kemi një rast konkret? Le të njihemi me vitusin Stuxnet...

programme.title: Shpëtimi i Notredamit
programme.desc: Natën e 15 prillit 2019, flakët e zjarrit, nuk po digjnin thjesht një ndërtesë, por zemrën e një Kombi. Historia e shpëtimit të Notre-Dame de Paris, një ikonë e Çmuar e arkitekturës dhe inxhinierisë, e ndërtuar përgjatë dy shekujve, simbol i kulturës së një Kombi. Historia unike në përpjekje për ta mbrojtur dhe rikonstruktuar.

programme.title: Prova e mbijetesës
programme.desc: Ata konsiderohen si armë luftarake nga më të papërballueshmet... Si trajnohen forcat ushtarake amerikane për t’u bërë më të mirë në Botë. Përzgjedhja, metodat, cilësitë, kapërcimi i limiteve njerëzore dhe provat e mbijetesës...

programme.title: Truri: Kush do të jemi ne
programme.desc: Një univers i tërë që ekziston brenda nesh. Një motor misterioz që krijon realitetin, kujtimet, emocionet, identitetin. Kush i kontrollon vendimet tona? Neuroshkencëtari i njohur Dr. David Eagleman, na shoqëron në një udhëtim mahnitës, duke zbuluar sekretet e trurit të njeriut. Nga mënyra si shohim botën sot, tek pyetja më e madhe: kush do të jemi nesër?

programme.title: Gara e re për hapësirën
programme.desc: Hëna duket si një tokë e djerrë, por në fakt është një minierë gjigante e pasur me thesare. Për hënën ka nisur një garë e dytë historike, e udhëhequr jo nga superfuqitë e Luftës së Ftohtë, por nga industria private. Kush do ta fitojë këtë garë?

programme.title: Mjekësia ligjore në provë
programme.desc: Shkenca e mjekësisë ligjore gjendet në krizë... Mënyrat më të besueshme për luftimin e krimit, mund të mos jenë aq të sigurta sa mendohej dikur... A do të munden teknologjitë e reja, të rikthejnë shkencën në mjekësinë ligjore?

programme.title: Forcat speciale
programme.desc: Seriali me gjashtë pjesë paraqet njësitë elitare të policisë në qytete të mëdha ndërkombëtare, konkretisht në Bukuresht, Moskë dhe Varshavë, teksa kryejnë operacione me rrezik të lartë, si bastisjet, lufta kundër krimit të organizuar dhe kundër-terrorizmit.

programme.title: Njeriu lëkurë flluskë
programme.desc: Një sëmundje e rrallë... Një burrë i pashëm indonezian, papritur fillon të transformohet në njeriun me fluska. A do të arrijnë dermatologët më të famshëm të botës të gjejnë një kurë shërimi? Një histori e vërtetë dhe pamje reale...

programme.title: Punët e vështira në aeroplanmbajtëse
programme.desc: Aeroplanmbajtëset janë fortesa lundruese. Janë arma më e madhe e arsenalit amerikan. Pse marinarët e tyre duhet të jenë të super stërvitur? Cila është përgatitja e tyre dhe deri ku arrin shkalla e vështirësisë së detyrave të ngarkuara?

programme.title: Ju paralajmëruam
programme.desc: Në internet, shkencëtarë të vetëshpallur filmojnë veten në aksion. Këta heronj bëjnë eksperimente të çuditshme, realizojnë shpikje të jashtëzakonshme... Ata të shndërrojnë sendet e zakonshme në shkencë të mahnitshme...

programme.title: Aksidente të çuditshme
programme.desc: Ndiqni rastet më të cuditshme të aksidenteve... Ku objekte të huaja arrijnë të hyjnë brenda në trupin tuaj... Si do munden doktorët ti zgjidhin këto raste kaq ekstreme dhe të shpëtojnë jetët e pacientëve?

programme.title: Megastrukturat naziste
programme.desc: Gjermania Naziste kujtohet për tragjedinë që i shkaktoi njerezimit. Por pas kësaj ka edhe një histori të arritjeve shkencore që shënuan fillimin e një revolucioni teknologjik. Zbuloni sekretet inxhinjerike të nazistëve...

programme.title: Super njerëzit 7
programme.desc: Njihuni me super njerëzit... Në dukje njerëz të zakonshëm, por me një fuqi të jashtëzakonshme, të cilët do të sfidojnë ligjet e natyrës përpara syve tuaj...

Askush se priste që ata të sillni një rrezik vdekjeprurës, i cili mund të kapërcehet vetëm nëse të gjithë punojnë së bashku. programme.title: Fashionista
programme.desc: “Fashionista” është konceptuar si emision që shërben si adresë e modës dhe adhuruesve të stilit. Përveç rubrikave për modën, emisioni sjellë edhe reportazhe ekskluzive që lidhen me këtë fushë. Emisioni me autore Kaltrina Hazirin vjen në ekranin e KTV-së çdo të shtunë nga ora 16:15, me një format të veçantë, duke sjellë rubrika kreative dhe informacione të përgjithshme që duhen ditur për trendët e modës.Shikuesit e KTV-së që pëlqejnë modën dhe duan të jenë në hap me trendët e rinj, do të mbesin të informuar për emisionin e tyre.

programme.title: Te Linda
programme.desc: Kuzhina më e popullarizuar televizive në Kosovë vjen në ekranin e Kohavisionit çdo ditë pune. Receta nga më të ndryshme me plot shije dhe delikatesë e të realizuara me shumë përkushtim edhe për nga ana vizuale, është pa dyshim adresa e duhur për t’u njohur me shijet e reja, por edhe ato tradicionale.

programme.title: Nëpër Film

programme.title: Sporti në KTV
programme.desc: Sporti në KTV është magazina ditore sportive që sjell pas lajmeve qendrore të gjitha zhvillimet kryesore në sport. Që nga futbolli i Kosovës, e deri tek arenat e tenisit në US Open. Çdo mbrëmje mund të informoheni për rezultatet e të gjitha sporteve dhe deklaratat e protagonistëve vendorë e ndërkombëtarë për sportet përkatëse.

programme.title: Rose
programme.desc: “Një Gotë Rose” sjellë një frymë tjetër në ciklin e emisioneve të pasditeve. Emisioni transmetohet cdo ditë, nga e hëna në të premte, ora 18:00.

Histori suksesi, personazhe interesante dhe rrëfime në studio janë pjesë e emisionit, i cili sjell çdo javë rubrikën e popullarizuar ”Shqiptarët nëpër botë”.

programme.title: Eksodi i Tokës
programme.desc: If Earth became uninhabitable, where would humans live? In Exodus Earth, the six-part series anchoring SPACE WEEK, physicist and host Dr. Basil Singer eagerly plays the role of human guinea pig to find answers. His mission is to investigate if humans could possibly call Mercury, Venus, Mars, Saturn’s moon Titan, and Jupiter’s moons Callisto and Gliese 581c home in the future. In the name of science, Dr. Singer subjects himself to extreme temperatures; tests new survival technologies designed to keep humans alive in harsh environments; suffers the rigors of travel in zero gravity; explores ideas for new human habitats in the sky; and more.

programme.title: Eksodi i Tokës
programme.desc: If Earth became uninhabitable, where would humans live? In Exodus Earth, the six-part series anchoring SPACE WEEK, physicist and host Dr. Basil Singer eagerly plays the role of human guinea pig to find answers. His mission is to investigate if humans could possibly call Mercury, Venus, Mars, Saturn’s moon Titan, and Jupiter’s moons Callisto and Gliese 581c home in the future. In the name of science, Dr. Singer subjects himself to extreme temperatures; tests new survival technologies designed to keep humans alive in harsh environments; suffers the rigors of travel in zero gravity; explores ideas for new human habitats in the sky; and more.

Rubrika të përjavshme dhe ditore. Ekipi i emisionit është i pranishëm çdo ditë në terren. Përmes rubrikës ”Hajt Pak”, programi është shndërruar në zërin e vërtetë të qytetarëve.

programme.title: Lajme TV Arta
programme.desc: Lajmet e fundit nga vendi dhe bota. Nje grup gazetaresh e redaktoresh sjellin te gjitha lajmet ne kohe reale nga secili skaj i Kosoves.

programme.title: Express Summer
programme.desc: ”Express” është emisioni televiziv me historinë më të gjatë në transmetim ndër televizionet kosovare. Në sezonin e shtatëmbëdhjetë vazhdon të jetë emisioni i pasdites për kosovarët. Magazina e pasdites në KTV është adresë për tema nga fusha të ndryshme, që nga zhvillimet politike e sociale, e deri te lajmet nga kultura, showbizi dhe sporti.

programme.title: Te Linda
programme.desc: Kuzhina më e popullarizuar televizive në Kosovë vjen në ekranin e Kohavisionit çdo ditë pune. Receta nga më të ndryshme me plot shije dhe delikatesë e të realizuara me shumë përkushtim edhe për nga ana vizuale, është pa dyshim adresa e duhur për t’u njohur me shijet e reja, por edhe ato tradicionale.

programme.title: Lajmet e mbrëmjes
programme.desc: Lajmet e Mbrëmjes, çdo mbrëmje nga ora 19:00, janë edicioni kryesor dhe më i besueshëm i lajmeve në Kosovë. Një grup gazetarësh e redaktorësh sjellin të gjitha lajmet nga politika deri te kultura, nga secili skaj i Kosovës. Në edicionin qendror të lajmeve ndër vite janë ekspozuar skandalet më të mëdha, keqpërdorimet enorme, gëzimet, festat, por edhe fatkeqësitë e popullit të Kosovës.

programme.title: Sporti në KTV
programme.desc: Sporti në KTV është magazina ditore sportive që sjell pas lajmeve qendrore të gjitha zhvillimet kryesore në sport. Që nga futbolli i Kosovës, e deri tek arenat e tenisit në US Open. Çdo mbrëmje mund të informoheni për rezultatet e të gjitha sporteve dhe deklaratat e protagonistëve vendorë e ndërkombëtarë për sportet përkatëse.

programme.title: In and Out
programme.desc: Të rejat nga showbizi, intervista pse jo edhe thashetheme të gjitha këto tashmë do të vijnë përmes emisionit më të ri që ka nisur transmetimin në RTV21 , “In and Out”, nën udhëheqjen e Granit Miftarit. Të mërkurën të enjten dhe të premten duke filluar nga ora 19: 30, Graniti do të jetë pranë jush për të dhënë më të rejat rreth personaliteteve të njohura, qoftë për karrierën e tyre e edhe për jetën private. Në edicionin e parë që u transmetua mbrëmë, mysafir i parë ishtë këngëtarja, Vesa Smolica e cila foli për pjesëmarrjen e saj në festivalin “Kënga Magjike”.

programme.title: In and Out
programme.desc: Të rejat nga showbizi, intervista pse jo edhe thashetheme të gjitha këto tashmë do të vijnë përmes emisionit më të ri që ka nisur transmetimin në RTV21 , “In and Out”, nën udhëheqjen e Granit Miftarit. Të mërkurën të enjten dhe të premten duke filluar nga ora 19: 30, Graniti do të jetë pranë jush për të dhënë më të rejat rreth personaliteteve të njohura, qoftë për karrierën e tyre e edhe për jetën private. Në edicionin e parë që u transmetua mbrëmë, mysafir i parë ishtë këngëtarja, Vesa Smolica e cila foli për pjesëmarrjen e saj në festivalin “Kënga Magjike”.

programme.title: In and Out
programme.desc: Të rejat nga showbizi, intervista pse jo edhe thashetheme të gjitha këto tashmë do të vijnë përmes emisionit më të ri që ka nisur transmetimin në RTV21 , “In and Out”, nën udhëheqjen e Granit Miftarit. Të mërkurën të enjten dhe të premten duke filluar nga ora 19: 30, Graniti do të jetë pranë jush për të dhënë më të rejat rreth personaliteteve të njohura, qoftë për karrierën e tyre e edhe për jetën private. Në edicionin e parë që u transmetua mbrëmë, mysafir i parë ishtë këngëtarja, Vesa Smolica e cila foli për pjesëmarrjen e saj në festivalin “Kënga Magjike”.

programme.title: Secrets of the Deep
programme.desc: The twentieth century bore witness to some of the most devastating naval battles in history. From the Arctic Sea to the South Pacific, colossal battleships met in desperate conflict alongside aircraft carriers, submarines and fleets of destroyers. But many of these ocean titans did not survive. They were destroyed by gunfire, torpedoes, and bombs, often with catastrophic loss of life. Through rarely seen archive, modern graphics, and exclusive interviews and analysis, this series explores eight of these amazing ships and the fates of those who served on them. From the brave British cruiser lost carrying Stalin’s gold, to an American submarine that vanished beneath the waves, these sunken warships all have secrets to be revealed and incredible stories to tell.

programme.title: Massive Engineering Mistakes
programme.desc: In Canada, tragedy strikes a bustling shopping mall. A massive mountain top dam in Missouri fails in minutes. Disaster in Melbourne, as a towering inferno takes hold. And in in Arkansas, ageing infrastructure threatens a town and the state’s finest fishing lake.

programme.title: Planes That Changed History
programme.desc: Discover the Chinook, the heavy-lift helicopter that rewrote the rules of aviation. Born in 1950s America, the Chinook entered service in Vietnam. Its bent airframe and tandem rotors gave it a huge lift capability, transforming U.S. military strategy.

programme.title: Planes That Changed History
programme.desc: During World War II, the B-17 became a formidable fortress of the skies. Uncover the technological and strategic innovations that made the B-17 a key to D-Day success, and later, Allied victory.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: From gold dental bands in Etruscan tombs to the blood stained remains of a medieval hospital in Scotland, archaeologists reveal the gritty realities of ancient care. A crafted Egyptian prosthetic adds a final twist, raising new questions about innovation in early medicine.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: A Chinese emperor gambles on a glittering elixir promising eternal life, while a fearless Renaissance anatomist challenges ancient medical doctrine. As the black death spreads across continents, desperate physicians search for answers in a race against unimaginable devastation.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: For centuries, Mary, Queen of Scots has been cast as impulsive and self-destructive. Now, through new evidence and rare access, Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow uncover deeper layers to this most famous historical figure; a queen who confronted violence, adversity and cunning enemies, and who skillfully played a perilous political game to the end.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: 1491, Ireland. A young man claims to be Richard, Duke of York, one of the missing Princes in the Tower. Backed by European powers, he poses a serious threat to English king Henry VII. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow reexamine the evidence behind one of history’s most persuasive pretenders. Was he, in fact, England’s rightful ruler?

programme.title: Në Skaj Të Të Panjohurës me Xhimi Çin
programme.desc: Kayaking legends Ben Stookesberry and Chris Korbuic accumulate together hundreds of first descents in the most dangerous rapids in the world; but the Lukuga River, in Congo, has left a particular mark on them.

programme.title: Sekretet e Groposura të Luftës së Dytë Botërore
programme.desc: The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor changed the world. Now new technology is revealing hidden traces of that attack, on the land and underwater.

programme.title: Sekretet e Groposura të Luftës së Dytë Botërore

programme.desc: Sending humans into space is perilous. Astronauts endure powerful launches, brutal reentry forces and an environment where small errors cause catastrophe. To prepare Orion for deep space, NASA studies past disasters to shape safer suits, escape systems and materials.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Tunnels save time, money, and the environment by providing shortcuts through tough terrain. But they can also be dangerous, especially as today’s tunnels grow longer and deeper. programme.title: Hitler’s Gold
programme.desc: Munich, September the 12th, 1919. History is about to be changed by a penniless army corporal thirsty to avenge his adoptive motherland. 13 years later, he will be saluted as the savior of the German nation. His name is Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Hitler’s Gold
programme.desc: Germany, 1937. By imposing his national economic policies by brute force, Adolf Hitler appears to be fulfilling his promise of returning Germany to prosperity within only 4 years. But there was an altogether more sinister side to this economic recovery and even as Germany was basking in the glow of her newfound confidence, Hitler and his cronies were selling her soul. In this episode, we reveal how the Nazis took absolute power over Germany with the financial backing of its industrial elite, and how Hitler would repay them by commissioning them the rearmament of the country, financed by an ingenious credit scheme created by financial wizard Hjalmar Schacht. We reveal how Gustav Krupp von Bohlen became the main industrial figure in the country, along with his financial contributions to the Führer, who himself made a fortune with his own publishing house and royalties. And finally, we reveal how Herman Göering’s plans for autarky would make way for Flick’s and IG Farben’s domination of the Reich economy, but at the same time, lead the country to the verge of economic collapse, and the need for expansion that would inevitably cause the deadliest conflict in the history of mankind.

And in China’s Turpan region, a burial wrapped in cannabis plants uncovers ritual practices and ancient knowledge.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: From Europe’s obsession with powdered mummy to Austrians who ingested arsenic for beauty and strength, history is filled with startling cures. Meanwhile, in Guatemala, an ancient Mayan sweat bath carved with a deity exposes healing practices centered on mothers and childbirth. These remedies reveal medicine’s most unexpected paths.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the ‘harlot’ who seduced Henry VIII into annulling his first marriage and forcing his country into religious turmoil. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow explore evidence that reveals a different Anne, whose ideas transformed England and whose reputation deserves reassessing.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex, was Elizabeth I’s golden boy: a charming, reckless war hero. He stood at the Queen’s side as she rallied troops against the Spanish Armada. But just twelve years on, he was executed for leading a rebellion. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow unpack Essex’s rapid rise and fall, and the court politics that sealed his fate.

programme.title: Sekretet e Groposura të Luftës së Dytë Botërore

programme.desc: The team investigate the Hurtgen Forest in Germany to uncover the hidden traces of the longest and bloodiest single battle in US army history.

programme.title: Sekretet e Groposura të Luftës së Dytë Botërore
programme.desc: In 1940 the Axis besieged the Mediterranean island of Malta. Pete Kelsey and Marty Morgan uncover how the most bombed place on earth fought back.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Flood risks are rising worldwide as storm surges and extreme rainfall overwhelm cities. Tokyo builds vast underground rivers to manage typhoons, while Spain’s Valencia floods highlight the need for early warnings. In New Orleans, storm surge barriers were reinvented after America’s worst flood disaster.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: The 2018 Morandi Bridge collapse was a global alarm bell, proving every structure has a lifespan. As demand, traffic and extreme weather grow, engineers rethink bridge safety. Genoa’s new span uses smart monitoring and robotics, while Turkey’s record-long suspension bridge pushes boundaries of innovation, enduring winds, collisions and earthquakes.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: From the Pantheon and its seemingly perfect dome to the gravity-defying Mont Saint-Michel and an enduring Roman gate that evolved into a medieval church, the exploration of history’s most sacred spaces uncovers how ancient builders channeled faith and ingenuity into architectural marvels.

programme.title: Zbulime Në Fund Të Oqeanit

In 1588, violent storms shattered the Spanish Armada along Ireland’s coast. Investigators hunt for these ships and unlock the role violent weather played in some of history’s most puzzling maritime disasters.

programme.title: Defektet më të rënda në botë
programme.desc: Gjithandej jemi të rrethuar me teknologji te avancuar. Por cfarë ndodh kur gjatë përdorimit, këta përbindësha të teknologjisë pësojnë difekte? Si riparohen? Kush janë vështirësitë që hasen për të riparuar defektet që u ndodhin këtyre mekanizmave.

programme.title: Vepra Të Braktisura
programme.desc: In the USA, at the heart of a Miami suburb, lies a strange structure that began as the dream of an American Renaissance man, but soon turned into a nightmare. In the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a high rise famed for its glitz and glamour, is drawn into a brutal conflict that consumed the country. On a quiet English Estuary, a marooned vessel once crewed by fun loving Pirates becomes the target of armed raiders. And, in Japan, an out-of-place curiosity, caught in a devastating web of corruption. Standing on the brink of collapse, some soon to be lost forever, these ruined sites have suffered through devastating natural disasters, years of violent wars, and events far more surprising. Within these decaying structures are the echoes of history – they speak of death and destruction, but also human ingenuity and endeavor; each haunted shell now ready to be unmasked and tell its own unique story.

programme.title: Lojërat e mendjes
programme.desc: Nga realiteti i hamendësuar tek paragjykimet dhe pritshmëritë që krijojnë lojërat e mendjes njerëzore, ky cikël dokumentarësh do të na ndihmojë t’i afrohemi më shumë pamjes së vërtetë së botës që na rrethon.

programme.title: The Human Family Tree
programme.desc: Renowned geneticist Dr. Spencer Wells, scientific leader of the Genographic Project, has uncovered evidence in our DNA which has led him to a revolutionary and timely theory about our journey across the planet. Working with scientists across multiple disciplines, he now believes that our treks in and out of Africa and, indeed, across the globe were driven by one force: dramatic changes in the earths climate.

programme.title: Audi Winter Games
programme.desc: Stunning scenery, world’s best talent and Kiwi hospitality is set to be showcased to a global audience with Winter Games New Zealand carrying out a diverse event yet again. Winter Olympic, Paralympic and X Games stars are heading to New Zealand’s Southern Alps once again for the first major winter sports championships of the season. They compete for glory in varied sports such as freestyle skiing, snowboarding, alpine skiing, cross-country skiing and curling. The Winter Games New Zealand are one of the world’s top five winter sports competitions and the only one in the southern hemisphere. They are also New Zealand’s largest recurring sports event. It’s a uniquely Kiwi experience that athletes, coaches, judges and spectators all rave about. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, sporting action and festival fun with live acts and DJs – host towns Queenstown and Wanaka look forward to the biggest party on southern snow!

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Inside Sailing

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race 2019
programme.desc: Gara andaluze e biçikletave është gara kryesore e biçikletave malore në Spanjë, e cila përbëhet nga gjashtë etapa dhe zgjat gjashtë ditë. Ritmi i garës nuk bie asnjë minutë gjatë këtyre gjashtë etapave. Në provën e fundit, çiklistët ngjiten në 1396 metra lartësi në mitikun Reventon dhe kalojnë përmes Trassierra-s, pastaj zbresin dhe përfundojnë në itinerarin e paharrueshëm Santo-Domingo. Një gabim në shtigjet shkëmbore do të thotë fundi i garës. Fituesit e edicionit të 9-të ishin spanjolli David Valero në garën e meshkujve dhe norvegjezja Hildegunn Hovdenak në atë të femrave.

programme.title: Audi Winter Games
programme.desc: Stunning scenery, world’s best talent and Kiwi hospitality is set to be showcased to a global audience with Winter Games New Zealand carrying out a diverse event yet again. Winter Olympic, Paralympic and X Games stars are heading to New Zealand’s Southern Alps once again for the first major winter sports championships of the season. They compete for glory in varied sports such as freestyle skiing, snowboarding, alpine skiing, cross-country skiing and curling. The Winter Games New Zealand are one of the world’s top five winter sports competitions and the only one in the southern hemisphere. They are also New Zealand’s largest recurring sports event. It’s a uniquely Kiwi experience that athletes, coaches, judges and spectators all rave about. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, sporting action and festival fun with live acts and DJs – host towns Queenstown and Wanaka look forward to the biggest party on southern snow!

programme.title: Cape Epic 2025
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Aussie Racer

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: CAPE EPIC 2022
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race 2019
programme.desc: Gara andaluze e biçikletave është gara kryesore e biçikletave malore në Spanjë, e cila përbëhet nga gjashtë etapa dhe zgjat gjashtë ditë. Ritmi i garës nuk bie asnjë minutë gjatë këtyre gjashtë etapave. Në provën e fundit, çiklistët ngjiten në 1396 metra lartësi në mitikun Reventon dhe kalojnë përmes Trassierra-s, pastaj zbresin dhe përfundojnë në itinerarin e paharrueshëm Santo-Domingo. Një gabim në shtigjet shkëmbore do të thotë fundi i garës. Fituesit e edicionit të 9-të ishin spanjolli David Valero në garën e meshkujve dhe norvegjezja Hildegunn Hovdenak në atë të femrave.

programme.title: Audi Winter Games
programme.desc: Stunning scenery, world’s best talent and Kiwi hospitality is set to be showcased to a global audience with Winter Games New Zealand carrying out a diverse event yet again. Winter Olympic, Paralympic and X Games stars are heading to New Zealand’s Southern Alps once again for the first major winter sports championships of the season. They compete for glory in varied sports such as freestyle skiing, snowboarding, alpine skiing, cross-country skiing and curling. The Winter Games New Zealand are one of the world’s top five winter sports competitions and the only one in the southern hemisphere. They are also New Zealand’s largest recurring sports event. It’s a uniquely Kiwi experience that athletes, coaches, judges and spectators all rave about. The relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, sporting action and festival fun with live acts and DJs – host towns Queenstown and Wanaka look forward to the biggest party on southern snow!

programme.title: Xterra Adventures
programme.desc: XTERRA is the world’s premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part “survival of the fittest”. The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Paragliding World Cup
programme.desc: Superfinalja e Kupës së Botës në Paragliding u zhvillua në Roldanillo, Kolumbi, me dhjetë ditë fluturime konkurruese në nivel të lartë në një nga vendet më të mira të paraglidingut në botë. Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Inside Sailing
programme.desc: Inside Sailing contains highlights from top sailing and yachting events around the world. It is a documentary show which educates the audience about the secrets of sailing, presents several exciting sea-side locations and offers a flavor of yachting lifestyle.

programme.title: Cape Epic 2019
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer’s calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

programme.title: Better Than Four
programme.desc: Initially a bi-weekly (26×26’) sports series with a difference, ‘Better Than Four’ brings viewers all the action from all things two-wheeled. As well as profiling past, present and future heroes of cycling, ‘Better Than Four’ includes news features and highlights from the very latest events. Each episode is also packed with tips and tricks to try at home, as well as reviews of the latest kit, equipment and cycling films. Changing gears from traditional cycling coverage, ‘Better Than Four’ takes viewers to new, exotic locations, from the volcano bike-ride in Bali to jungle biking around the Mayan temples of South America. Each episode will include up to 3 segments covering cycling and biking events from all over the world. With amazing footage and commentary from experienced cyclists, daredevil skills and awe-inspiring camerawork, this groundbreaking show is a must for cycling enthusiasts and novices alike.

Njëqind e njëzet e dy pilotë morën pjesë, përfshirë 18 fitues të mëparshëm të përgjithshëm të Kupës së Botës dhe 12 fituese të Kupës së Botës për Femra, duke e renditur atë si një nga garat më të vështira që janë përballur ndonjëherë me njëri-tjetrin. Të pezulluar në ajër, ky sport aventurier përfshin gara në distanca të gjata, ku pilotët duhet të jenë ekspertë në kuptimin e ndikimit të terrenit në kushtet e motit.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world’s fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You’ll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it’s prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia’s Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted “World’s Best Zoo” two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man’s passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He’s on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he’s rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature’s Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature’s Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it’s also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth’s crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo’s Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray’s cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett’s tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He’s on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he’s rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India’s most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal’s construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider’s perspective.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building blocks of the planets and perhaps carry the origins of life itself. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Everyday elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It’s the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We’ll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you’ll visit America’s first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It’s been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: The PAST Hunters

programme.title: The R.I.P. Files
programme.desc: The R.I.P. team visits the former home of the last woman hanged for witchcraft in Virginia and encounters the spirit of the still fiercely protective foreman of her farm.

programme.title: What in the World?

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Earthquakes have always been with us, but only in recent decades has their devastating impact been captured so vividly on film and online. In this episode, we explore scenes from some of the most destructive natural cataclysms. Of all disasters, none releases more energy than an earthquake—caused when Earth’s plates grind and snap, shaking hundreds of square miles. Most occur in the Pacific “Ring of Fire.” Alaska sees a 7.0 quake yearly, while California experiences about 10,000, most too small to notice.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ – experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The PAST Hunters
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men’s club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial – a predator – that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia – a Tiger Quoll – smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird’s eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd’s Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray’s cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett’s tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he’s got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he’s brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo’s history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friends
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world – the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster – North America’s largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus – Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider – Hidden in messy webs, the female’s scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web – Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra – Africa’s iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles – The world’s most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern – These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans – Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks – Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world’s largest Octopus. You’ll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature’s battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: On the Cities’ Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.desc: Humans have long dreamed of flight—from da Vinci’s flapping-wing designs to massive cow-gut-filled airships. The Wright brothers, inspired by bicycles, built strong, controllable kites that led to early planes. Modern jets fly faster thanks to high-altitude, low-resistance flight, an idea sparked by Frank Whittle’s Aeolipile experiments. From the Airbus A380 to NASA’s scramjet, aviation keeps evolving—what’s next in flight innovation?

And, have you ever noticed those colored spinning poles outside the barbershop? You’ll be in stitches when you learn how they got their start! Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the microwave!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!

And finally, we’ll ”cut to the chase” and explain the history behind this common phrase!

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: New satellites are being launched to continue detailed observations of Earth and its oceans an ice caps, They are finding that climate change is accelerating and they have the data to prove it.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be shortly followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us here on Earth.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots’ balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He’s on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he’s rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The R.I.P. Files
programme.desc: Major Graham’s Mansion, in the Virginia countryside, houses dark secrets that the team attempts to uncover.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia – the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature – the weedy sea dragon – a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin – the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world – the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters – albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy’s ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia’s wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque’s head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque’s Head of Environmental Affairs, it’s all part of the job! He’s hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research - but first he’s just got to locate the turtle - 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: ‘Finding Nemo’ may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao’s not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friends
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Archer Fish – A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider – Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell – A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider – Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants – Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion – A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp – Hunts spiders with deadly precision. Who rules the micro predator world?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Ocean Odyssey: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You’ll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it’s prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia’s Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: On the Cities’ Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Edison didn’t invent the light bulb—he made it practical. Early lighting included unsafe limelight and blinding arc lamps. Edison tested thousands of filaments, even a beard hair, to improve bulb life. Others explored gas-based bulbs, leading to energy-saving lamps. Lasers, once Einstein’s theory, became essential tech. Today, lighting innovations include invisible wavelengths and even laser therapy. What’s next in the evolution of light?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell’s principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It’s the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We’ll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you’ll visit America’s first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It’s been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year’s end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: The New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA - JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.
